name: claudetto-browser
description: Drives a browser with `agent-browser`, or with CloakBrowser on sites with bot detection when the user chooses it. With the `cloakbrowser` backend, answers each `WebSearch` call that the permission rules allow with a search in CloakBrowser, and needs its binary.

backend.title: Browser backend
backend.description: Use `agent-browser` (the default), or `cloakbrowser` for sites with bot detection. CloakBrowser runs only when you choose it here. It runs through `agent-browser` with its own Chromium binary. Only `cloakbrowser` answers `WebSearch` with a browser search, because search engines give the plain browser a bot check. With `agent-browser`, the built-in `WebSearch` answers.
